title: Decomposing Staleness in Recommender Systems: A Dual-Filter Framework for Supersession and Decay
abstract: arXiv:2608.15780v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Stale recommendations are a pervasive challenge and a leading source of user complaints on large-scale content platforms. Items lose relevance through two primary mechanisms: supersession, where emerging updates render prior coverage stale, and relevance decay, where an item's informational value naturally diminishes over its lifecycle. Traditional countermeasures serve as crude proxies: age cutoffs poorly reflect actual relevance loss, while engagement heuristics rely on lagging signals, broadly exposing users to stale content before the system adapts.   We present SDF (Supersession-Decay Filtering), a staleness filtering system fully deployed in Google Discover, a personalized recommendation feed with hundreds of millions of daily and billions of monthly active users. translated_title: 推荐系统中的过时性分解：用于替代与衰减的双重过滤框架
translated_abstract: 过时推荐是一个普遍存在的挑战，也是大规模内容平台上用户投诉的主要原因之一。物品通过两种主要机制失去相关性：替代，即新兴更新使先前的覆盖内容过时；以及相关性衰减，即物品的信息价值在其生命周期中自然减少。传统对策作为粗略的代理手段：年龄截止点无法准确反映实际的相关性损失，而参与度启发式方法依赖滞后信号，在系统适应之前广泛地将用户暴露于过时内容中。我们提出了SDF（替代-衰减过滤），一个完全部署在Google Discover中的过时性过滤系统，这是一个拥有数亿日活跃用户和数十亿月活跃用户的个性化推荐信息流。SDF通过互补的过滤器针对这两种机制，每个过滤器由学习模型驱动：一个关系性过时模型，用于检测物品对之间的替代关系；以及一个衰减模型，用于评估物品的相关性随时间下降的程度。我们提供了离线评估和在线实验结果，证明SDF在减少过时推荐方面显著优于基线方法，同时保持用户参与度指标，并在生产环境中展示了其可扩展性和鲁棒性。
tldr: 本文提出了一个双重过滤框架SDF，分别针对替代和衰减两种过时机制进行建模，并在Google Discover大规模部署中有效减少过时推荐，同时保持用户参与度。
en_tdlr: This paper introduces SDF, a dual-filter framework that models supersession and decay separately to reduce stale recommendations at scale in Google Discover, improving freshness without sacrificing user engagement.
